title: Starfleet Bridge Crew
pitch: Boros Starfleet officers: go wide, hit total power 8, swing.

title: Section 31 Tactical Command
pitch: Orzhov midrange: answers for every kind of threat, Picard and ships to close.

title: Worf's Away Team
pitch: Worf, Son of Mogh pumps Officers; draw a second card each turn to make more.

title: Abaddon's Black Legion
pitch: Chaos Space Marines: hit first, then cascade into Daemon Primarchs.

title: The Doctor's TARDIS Crew
pitch: The Fourth Doctor and Sarah Jane: cast historic spells off the top, ten Doctors aboard.

title: Living End
pitch: Cycle creatures into the graveyard, cascade into Living End, swap boards.

title: Hammer Time
pitch: Cheat Colossus Hammer onto a tiny creature and win in one swing.

title: Fleet Command
pitch: Affinity: cheap artifacts launch drones, arm the Cannoneer and fire munitions.

title: Cryptid Sightings
pitch: Sultai midrange: Psychic Frog, Lhurgoyfs, a Chupacabra and the Loch Ness serpent.

title: DS9: Defend the Station
pitch: Boros station defense: burn and phasers hold the line while Picard, Worf and Kira lead the counterattack.

title: LOTR: Ride of the Rohirrim
pitch: Boros cavalry: Rohan's riders charge in waves while Théoden, Éomer and Éowyn lead the charge.

title: Gryffindor Courage
pitch: Boros lifegain aggro: lions, hawks and clerics gain life to grow Ajani's Pridemate while Bolt and Helix clear the way.

title: Leo's Squad (TMNT)
pitch: Mono-white Ninja Turtles: go wide with Mutants and Ninjas, then sneak Leonardos into the attack for big swings.

title: Pyromancer's Inferno
pitch: Mono-red spells: every burn spell also makes a token, untaps Thermo-Alchemist or fires Guttersnipe.

title: Team Avatar Allies
pitch: Mono-white Allies: each new Ally grows the team, gains life and draws cards until Aang and Appa fly over.

title: Whispering Hollow
pitch: Selesnya tokens: spirits and saprolings multiply, and Intangible Virtue makes every token a threat.

title: Call of the Deep Dark
pitch: Mono-black midrange: deathtouch blockers and removal grind the opponent down until Nightmare takes over.

title: For the Horde
pitch: Mono-red goblins: flood the board with hasty goblin tokens, pump them with Goblin Chieftain and swarm.

title: Scholomance Necromancers
pitch: Mono-black zombies: an undying horde that returns from the graveyard, led by zombie lords and Grave Titan.

title: Forest Friends Starter
pitch: Mono-green beginner stompy: ramp with elves, play bigger creatures each turn and win fights with pump spells.

title: Night Owls
pitch: Orzhov night flyers: Owlin and Bats gain and lose life every turn, and each life change drains the opponent or pumps the flock.

title: The Restricted Section
pitch: Azorius library control: Narset keeps opponents to one card a turn, Day's Undoing refills your hand, and Wan Shi Tong, Librarian guards the stacks.

title: Jam Session
pitch: Izzet prowess improv: cheap spells riff off each other, Harmonic Prodigy doubles Slickshot Show-Off's solos, and burn closes the set.

title: Things That Go Bump
pitch: Bant Spirits: flash in phantoms and apparitions with Aether Vial and Collected Company, pump them with ghostly lords and haunt the skies.

title: Rainbow Stables
pitch: Selesnya ponies: lifelink unicorns and pegasi gain life every turn, and Crested Sunmare turns it into a herd of 5/5 Horses.

title: Who Needs Lands?
pitch: Mono-red Belcher with zero real lands: rituals into Goblin Charbelcher, which reveals your entire land-free library for 20+ damage on turn 2.
